## Business Overview
Tailchat offers a focused space for real-time communication among professionals in modern teams.

**Ideal Customer:** 
Tech-savvy project managers and team leads who need efficient collaboration tools to streamline workflows.
They are likely located within urban tech hubs, working remotely or with hybrid work models. Their income levels would be moderate-to-high due to the professional services they offer.
